name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
adventurer, next I must have you capture a creature that in appearance, may look quite fragile, yet its powerful spirit is what we are truly after. The faerie dragons that I speak of have served the night elves as their allies. We must capture one so that the horde may benefit from this strength of spirit as well.

Here is the muisek, adventurer. Kill 8 sprite darters or sprite dragons, and capture their muisek. They may be found to the west of here.
narrative.objectives: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you, adventurer. Now the spiritual powers of the faerie dragon will be available to us.

I hope you willing to perform another task for me.
narrative.requestItemsText: Were you able to capture the muisek of the faerie dragons?

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 45 to 50, 29,325 XP in all.

quests.name: A Strange Request
quests.objectiveText: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

quests.name: Testing the Vessel
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin.

quests.name: Hippogryph Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

quests.name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons.

quests.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants.

quests.name: Weapons of Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
